caseName: Kunkle v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division
caseNameFull: Kunkle v. Dretke, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Correctional Institutions Division

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Ste *1133 vens, Justice Souter, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
